//   Units stack in PARALLEL (foil tabs align and contact) to add capacitance

//   V_working = 4500 / 3 = 1500 V per layer (3× safety factor)
//   2 layers: V_working = 3000 V — more than adequate for 500W transmitter
//   N units in parallel → C_total = N × C_unit
//   Units connect with copper foil tabs at front edge (bottom-to-bottom
//   Velcro on PVC side faces holds mechanical stack
//   Spring contact strip (phosphor bronze) on tab edge ensures reliable parallel connection
